# Crew API: workflows (Public endpoints)

Part of the [Crew API reference](README.md).

## GET /v1/crew/workflows/runs

List workflow runs started by this grant.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | stable |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `workflows:run`. The app also needs the entitlement `workflows.run`. |

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `after` | string | no | Start after this id. |
| `limit` | integer (1 to 100, default `20`) | no |  |

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |

Response `200`: Success.

Response headers:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-Id` | string | One id per request, supplied by the caller or an intermediary, or generated by the gateway. Also written to the audit log and the error body. |
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | The server's minor version, for example 1.3. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Limit` | number | This grant's daily credit ceiling. Sent on every response to a delegated-credential request, success or failure; not sent for the embed credential. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining` | number | Credits left today (reservations already subtracted). |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Reset` | integer | When the quota resets, Unix seconds. |

Response body fields (`application/json`), [WorkflowRunList](schemas.md#workflowrunlist):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `object` | `list` | yes |  |
| `data` | array of [WorkflowRun](schemas.md#workflowrun) | yes |  |
| `first_id` | string or null | no |  |
| `last_id` | string or null | no |  |
| `has_more` | boolean | yes |  |

## POST /v1/crew/workflows/runs

Start a workflow run.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | stable |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `workflows:run`. The app also needs the entitlement `workflows.run`. |

Only saved workflows the user marked "allow third parties". Spends credits and runs several agents in parallel; counted against the grant quota and watched by the gateway's monitor.

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | Accepted by every Public POST. Within one grant, a retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first result (the same object id) and is neither run again nor charged again; the same key with a different body is 422 idempotency_key_reused. |

Request body fields (`application/json`), [CreateWorkflowRunRequest](schemas.md#createworkflowrunrequest):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workflow` | string | yes |  |
| `args` | object | no |  |
| `input` | string | no |  |
| `budget_total` | integer | no | Token ceiling; cannot exceed the grant quota. |

Response `202`: Success.

Response headers:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-Id` | string | One id per request, supplied by the caller or an intermediary, or generated by the gateway. Also written to the audit log and the error body. |
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | The server's minor version, for example 1.3. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Limit` | number | This grant's daily credit ceiling. Sent on every response to a delegated-credential request, success or failure; not sent for the embed credential. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining` | number | Credits left today (reservations already subtracted). |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Reset` | integer | When the quota resets, Unix seconds. |

Response body fields (`application/json`), [WorkflowRun](schemas.md#workflowrun):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `object` | `workflow.run` | yes |  |
| `workflow` | string or null | no | Slug of a saved workflow. |
| `status` | `queued`, `running`, `finished`, `failed`, `cancelled` | yes |  |
| `created_at` | [Timestamp](schemas.md#timestamp) | yes | Unix seconds. |
| `finished_at` | integer or null | no |  |
| `result` | any | no | The workflow's return value; its shape is defined by the workflow. |
| `error` | string or null | no |  |
| `usage` | [Usage](schemas.md#usage) | no |  |
